title: Unit Shiha Distribution and its Applications to Engineering and Medical Data
summary: There is a growing need for flexible statistical distributions that can accurately model data defined on the unit interval. This paper introduces a new unit distribution, termed the unit Shiha (USh) distribution, which is derived from the original Shiha (Sh) distribution through an inverse exponential transformation. The probability density function of the USh distribution is sufficiently flexible to model both left- and right-skewed data, while its hazard rate function is capable of capturing various failure-rate patterns, including increasing, bathtub-shaped, and J-shaped forms.
